statements: VC-26.1: "this repo would keep depending on the PUBLISHED solid-pod-rs crate (Cargo.toml:222, 0.4.0-alpha.15) and delete the extraction/solid-pod-rs mirror, moving to the post-port crate version in lockstep with the forum. reason: Cargo.toml now pins solid-pod-rs (and its sibling crates) at =0.5.0-alpha.12 in lockstep with the forum via a [patch.crates-io] entry, so the topic's claim that the repo is on 0.4.0-alpha.15 and that lockstep is only proposed is now wrong. The other changes only add an `inherited: false` field to ACL builders, which the topic doesn't contradict.
